messages:
Ali (AE): demo with Arcadia stalled — streaming answer cut mid-sentence ~10s in, browser JSON.parse error. They called this a purchase blocker.

Rosa (solutions): can you paste repro and which browser/proxy? Also pricing question: would Dedicated remove this since their traffic goes through corporate GateKeeper?

Ali (AE): Chrome + Arcadia GateKeeper (corp proxy). Using hosted API, model=redwood-chat-medium, stream=true. Customer wants a short, clear explanation for security team.

Diego (eng): quick theory: intermediate proxy is resetting idle streaming connections (15s default) and that results in truncated chunked responses -> client sees partial JSON. Also saw a few 401s from auth refresh around the same time which could aggravate.

Nora (platform): infra: observed proxy-originated FIN at 1998765455 for that session. Upstream nginx reported a 502 proxied at 1998765456. No global 429s. Auth logs show token refresh spike at 1998765454 for that client.

Rosa (solutions): client console snippet from customer: 
```
EventSource opened
onmessage: data len=200
onmessage: data len=32 -> invalid json
Uncaught SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input
reconnect in 1s
fetch error: net::ERR_CONNECTION_RESET
```

Diego (eng): recommended customer checks: 1) Have GateKeeper increase idle timeout to >=60s for SSE paths. 2) Disable buffering/inspection for `Accept: text/event-stream`. 3) Ensure proxy forwards `Connection: keep-alive` and does not gzip or transform. If they run nginx, set `X-Accel-Buffering: no`.

Nora (platform): server-side mitigations we can deploy fast: send comment heartbeats every 8s, add `retry:1500`, set `Cache-Control: no-transform`, and enable a tolerant auth window so short auth-refresh races don't cause stream aborts. I'll queue a canary. ops-bot: schedule canary for sse-heartbeat.

ops-bot: Canary scheduled: sse-heartbeat=8s on 3 hosts; rollout window 20m.

Diego (eng): SDK mitigation: buffer partial chunks and attempt to reassemble across reconnect. Example snippet we can give them now: 
```
let buf='';
es.onmessage = e => { buf += e.data; try { const obj = JSON.parse(buf); handle(obj); buf=''; } catch(e) { /* wait for next chunk */ } };
es.onopen = () => console.log('sse open');
es.onerror = () => { /* backoff reconnect, keep buf */ };
```

Rosa (solutions): i'll send the customer the two-pronged note: 1) quick firewall/proxy config changes to test, 2) temporary SDK snippet to tolerate truncation, 3) Dedicated/private deployment option if they want to remove corporate proxy from path. Also ask GateKeeper admin to run a bypass test.

Ali (AE): customer wants security wording around auth rotation — can we provide a short blurb?

Diego (eng): yes: "We use short-lived tokens with automatic refresh. Our runtime tolerates a single in-flight request during token rotation; transient 401s may occur during refresh but should not cause intentional mid-event stream termination. Abrupt truncation is symptomatic of network proxy reset or buffering."

Nora (platform): leaving this open until canary completes. last related event 1998765558, no repeats in monitoring since canary queued.

Ali (AE): thanks team — sending update to Arcadia with instructions and offering to coordinate GateKeeper admin test tomorrow. :pray:
